I went a little too hard on BUY HARD’s first interface.

Metallic finishes, painted labels, vintage audio gear. I liked the look, but it quickly became hard to use.

This is the short version of how I got from that to the simpler lime interface: fewer distractions, clearer language, and a buyer you can talk to.

The archived and current screens use different sample scenarios. This is a look at my design decisions.

Let me know what you think.
